value.rationale: For a natural two-sex exclusion threshold, the known first-order crossover has an N-dependent finite-generation bias of logarithmic reciprocal size. The two explicit sign-sensitive coefficients quantify which population deficit lags the continuum trajectory and provide a uniform correction over a macroscopic time window; this precise nonzero second-order statistic is neither a renaming nor a restatement of the earlier leading population law. The calculation may be technically elementary but is a motivated sharp asymptotic at a nonhyperbolic dynamical boundary.
